column2: Establish customs offices and a local administrative council in the districts held by Italy. The charter records the protectorate's local claims while preserving existing communities and titles.
Commission a railway survey and local construction programme. Work requires secure Italian administration and an undeveloped district. Foreign territory cannot be incorporated through this programme.

The ministry closes the construction programme. A secure, undeveloped district still under Italian administration can receive the planned railway. If the necessary territory has been lost, the expedition and survey expenses cannot recover it.
